P11.rationale: The right panel displays large typographic data points ('>200.000 €', '4 automatisierte Kernprozesse', '24 Std. → Minuten') that are clearly bound to real outcome numbers, functioning as before/after cost-math callouts, though there are no chart or graph visualisations.
